findings.what: The overlap check 'two tasks writing the same files with no dependency' targets a state the runtime already resolves: overlapping scopes serialize.
findings.failureScenario: A builder writes a second overlap detector that flags plans the scheduler would run correctly, producing false findings and a duplicate of the conflict logic.
findings.suggestion: Drop the overlap half, or reuse scopePatternsConflict only to report serialization the owner may not expect; keep the 'path not in the repository map' half.

findings.what: The ranking, threshold, piece splitting and backtest machinery exists to choose which of five cheap read-only reviewers run. One reviewer (overlap check) already always runs and Zoom out/Grounding/Comprehension are named in build order as all being built; running all five on every complex-and-clear plan may cost less than the decision model, the setting, the backtest and the derived-none path.
findings.failureScenario: Build step 1 (largest unit) ships before anyone measures whether selection saves anything over always running all five, and the size pick alone (needed for the simple/complex split) could be a single forced choice.
evidence: plan: 'Each gets the stored plan, the repository map and read access'; 'mid-price model (about half the cost of the Architect's)'
plan: 'Build order 1. Decision model setting and the decision step, with the backtest script.'
src/webgpu/decisions.ts:28 only choice/score forced decisions exist
findings.suggestion: Make step 1 the size pick only; add agent ranking later if measured per-plan agent cost justifies it.

findings.what: A new 'review the plan' tool and 'resolve a finding' tool sit beside lz-verify-task, the existing Architect self-review, and its refusal limits.
findings.failureScenario: Two overlapping review tools with different limits and vocabularies; the Architect's prompt must explain when to use each.
evidence: plan: 'The self-review tool's limits on checks, evidence and rounds are deliberate'
findings.suggestion: State how the new tool relates to lz-verify-task (per task versus per plan) or fold plan-level review into it.

findings.what: A six-state planning machine plus two tables is fixed before the flow is proven; saving a draft plan already exists (draft true on the plan tool).
findings.failureScenario: States and tables are built in step 2 and reshaped once the agent-session and plan-link checks (stated as unconfirmed) land.
evidence: src/runner/tools.ts:23 'set draft true only to save it without admitting'
plan: 'Before building: confirm in OpenCode that one tool call can start an agent session'
findings.suggestion: Defer the machine states and table columns until after the pre-build confirmations; store the first plan draft as plain text.

findings.what: Splitting rule (about four sentences, one-sentence overlap) and 'twice' forced choice are fixed before the backtest that the plan says measures them.
findings.failureScenario: Constants change after the backtest, redoing the piece splitter.
evidence: plan: 'a long paragraph splits at about four sentences with a one-sentence overlap'
findings.suggestion: Mark the split size and repeat count as backtest outputs.
